status: accepted-risks-only register (no open blockers at the time of writing; each risk has a mitigation + evidence pointer)

risks.risk: Density-padding (densDrop) bytes in the exec3/terminal unlocks are unauthenticated filler
risks.impact: An attacker can mutate the padding without breaking the verifier; the padding is data-only (inside data pushes), cannot execute, cannot exceed the pinned unlock lengths, and cannot alter any authenticated material
risks.mitigation: inputLengthGuards pin the unlock lengths; the padding carries no code; both VMs (libauth + LeanBCH + BCHN consensus) agree the windows are the only accepted mutation surface; scoped tamper corpus 0/2088 on the authenticated bytes

risks.risk: Single-contributor ceremony material reused (no new multi-party ceremony)
risks.impact: The ceremony's toxic-waste assumption rests on the single contributor's honest deletion; the VK d38f3cfc is fixed in the deployment
risks.mitigation: explicitly accepted per the revised goal (ceremonyQualified=false, documented reuse); the ceremony chain (ptau e7aec1da -> beta.zkey 61683ef2) is hash-pinned

risks.risk: Hot-wallet custody model for the chipnet funding UTXOs (P2PKH, single key)
risks.impact: Key compromise = loss of the (chipnet-only) funds; no mainnet exposure
risks.mitigation: chipnet-only; the wallet is a test wallet; the 0x61 sighash covers the full outputs; keys never printed/logged

risks.risk: 0x61 (allOutputsAllUtxos) sighash coverage leaves the fee input's lock free
risks.impact: The covenant authenticates the pool surface (roles 0-7); the funding input (8) is authenticated by its own P2PKH; a carrier substitution of the funding lock would break the P2PKH
risks.mitigation: the fee input's P2PKH + the txTopologyGuard's 9-input pin; verified by the consensus tamper corpus (fee flip rejected)

risks.impact: The evidence describes chipnet settlements only
risks.mitigation: all evidence JSONs carry chipnet-scoped schemas; the release scans enforce the external-release-gate boundaries
